comment: SPIKE (WP-2). What built BmlibFFI.xcframework and Sources/BmlibCore/bmlib_ffi.swift. Both are regenerated together, from one bmlib commit, by bmlib's rust/bmlib-ffi/scripts/build-xcframework.sh; a binding generated from another commit fails UniFFI's checksum check at first call. treeSha256 is the SHA-256 of the sorted list of '<path> <sha256>' (and '<path> -> <target>' for symlinks) over every file in the xcframework.
